test_title: PYST 21: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: KHIG is related to HEFD in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, DABZ is related to AXYW. To which of the given options is BYZX related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, KHIG is related to HEFD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/808cdd8802a8c8bc828c2dcdd02c1bd2b28dad2bc8129f4dd8a5e6ca2f2c4118.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47c509ae768df68506d1180e2c75e7a11089058d8e299fd27cebb3223dc29fcd.png] 

For, DABZ is related to AXYW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b7fed21c0b783490ccc54443875ef6c2e5ae532762488ac4089dbd99c0b18d9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8ae813728d170002f2d441b68ec3275a7a91b50b77d38f14a3cd5e1ff33bd9c.png] 

Similarly, for **BYZX**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/693dd8a92327b0c7c3d02d34e597ee7262b10bde7bece8dbae9e30f897e0a2c0.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bc1b0a049fb2aa12a61f9e161b76a012ca06f9192c4a4da78b8d366d14502d1.png] 

So, **BYZX** will be related to **YVWU**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
